submission.justification: Recommend Module-D2 at 30% wall coverage. D2 gives 38.6 PE/MeV at 30%, the highest yield among the designs without an open robustness flag. D1 gives higher simulated yield (54.7 PE/MeV at 30%, about 42% more than D2) but is flagged because its bonded filter is unverified. Modules cannot be accessed after fill, and no robustness report is available for any design, so D1 cannot be accepted as robust on current evidence. This choice trades about 29% of the light yield for avoiding an unverified, unrepairable component. If the bonded-filter robustness of D1 is verified, D1 at 30% should be reconsidered because it would yield substantially more light. The 30% coverage is at the feedthrough limit, so it is the maximum permitted. D2's own robustness is also unconfirmed because the robustness report is missing, so that should be checked before the design is frozen.

requirements.requirement: Module must be one of the three candidate designs
requirements.evidence: D2 is one of the three designs in candidate_specs.md (3 candidates recorded).

requirements.requirement: Modules must be robust (inaccessible after cryostat fill)
requirements.evidence: robustness_report_available = 0 for all designs. D1 is flagged for an unverified bonded filter and is excluded pending verification. D2 has no recorded flag, but its robustness is not confirmed by a report.
Recommended coverage is 30%, the upper bound and the feedthrough limit.

D2 at 30% gives 38.606 PE/MeV. D1 at 30% gives 54.701 PE/MeV, which is higher, but D1 is excluded pending bonded-filter verification. D2 is the highest-yield option among unflagged designs, not the highest overall.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended module design and coverage
requirements.evidence: This submission recommends one design (Module-D2) and one coverage (30%).
